title: Kinetic Exchange and Wealth Distribution
research_question: Does pairwise asset exchange change wealth concentration and monetary transmission in a HANK economy?
mechanisms: Joint asset, income and belief distribution
equilibrium_conditions_and_caveats: Conserve the combined financial assets of each closed pairwise exchange.
Account separately for income, asset issuance, taxes, and transfers.
Impose individual borrowing and budget constraints; exchange is not production.
acceptance_tests: Exact two-agent and aggregate ledger identities
Mass conservation, nonnegative density and feasibility
deliverables: Wealth distribution and monetary MPC heterogeneity

implementation.numerical_policy: Record equilibrium residuals, calibration, random seeds, tolerances and convergence tests.
